articles.title: Spain Wins the Biggest World Cup Ever — But Was It Too Big?
articles.summary: Spain beat Argentina in the final of the first 48-team World Cup. Fans loved new teams like Cape Verde, but many booed the new hydration breaks that stopped the game for drinks.

articles.title: The UK's New Prime Minister Has Big Plans — But How Will He Pay for Them?
articles.summary: Andy Burnham just became the UK's new PM, and he wants to help people with the cost of living, build more houses, and end rough sleeping. But these ideas cost billions of pounds, and no one knows where the money will come from.

articles.title: Gas Prices Are Rising Again — Here's Why Your Family's Road Trip Just Got More Expensive
articles.summary: Tensions between the US and Iran are pushing gas prices up. The average price hit $4 per gallon in the US, and oil tankers are avoiding a key waterway called the Strait of Hormuz, which carries a fifth of the world's oil.
